The '''Havocs''' were a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] active in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tal'cara]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were responsible for sacking the city on their [[Skybird]] [[swoop/Legends|swoops]], specifically considering the area around [[Warehouse district (Tal'cara)|warehouse district]] their territory. However they were quick to flee if the beings they tried to intimidate showed some opposition.
